arilinkUrl.description: URL of the AriLink server (e.g., http://localhost:3011)

autoAnswer.description: Automatically answer incoming calls and route to AI

greeting.description: Text spoken to caller when call is answered (TTS)
greeting.default: Hello, how can I help you today?

silenceTimeoutMs.description: Hang up after this many ms of silence (0 = never)

maxCallDurationMs.description: Maximum call duration in ms (0 = unlimited)
